lines.text: Asaph says the nations have invaded God's inheritance, defiled His holy temple, and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
God's servants' bodies were given as food to the fish of the sea, and no one buries the dead.
Neighbors scorn them, and Asaph asks God to pour out His wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge Him.
Asaph asks God to help them, atone for their sins, and not let the nations ask where their God is.
Asaph asks God to hear the captives' groans, and His people, the sheep of His vineyard, will thank Him forever.
